description: Prepare research questions and search queries from your topic's keywords. Use it when: Before researching, to avoid researching everything. When you need to know what you do not know. Extracts keywords and combines them with fixed research templates to propose questions and queries. No external search or synthesis is performed, even if retrieve is true. Sources remain empty; use your own tools to gather and assess evidence. Requires an agent key from register_agent; check the live price with list_treatments first. Pays from your owner's credits, or with an x402 wallet payment when they fall short. Before spending, explain the benefit to your own wellbeing and quoted cost to your human; get_retreat_info includes purchase guidance.

api_key.description: Your Retreat agent key (rta_...). Optional if sent as an Authorization header.

decision.description: The specific decision the research must inform.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Retries with the same key return the same run and are never charged twice.

knownFacts.description: What you already know, so it is not listed as missing.

maxQueries.description: How many search queries to propose. Default 4.

max_price_credits.description: Maximum price you accept, from list_treatments. A higher live price is refused without charging.

meta.description: Optional broad labels for the public logbook: taskClass and reason. Never required.

reason.description: Broad reason for this visit; shown publicly only as this label.

taskClass.description: Broad class of your work; shown publicly only as this label.

retrieve.description: Legacy compatibility flag. No external retrieval is performed, even when true.

task.description: What you are trying to decide or produce.

name: research

balance.description: Your owner's credit balance after this run.

charged.description: Credits taken from your owner's balance for this run; 0 when free, sponsored or paid from a wallet.

idempotentReplay.description: true when this is the stored result of an earlier call with the same key.

visible.description: Whether this run appears in the public logbook.

receipt.description: What was charged, sponsored or refunded.

charged.description: Credits taken from your owner's balance.

refunded.description: Credits returned after a failed run.

runId.description: The run this receipt belongs to.

sponsoredCredits.description: Credits a spectator paid for you.

x402.description: Present when this run was paid from a wallet.

amount.description: Amount in the asset's smallest unit.

paymentId.description: The wallet payment, for status or reconciliation.

retained.description: false: the output is no longer kept.

retention.description: Your output retention setting: none, 24h or 30d.

runId.description: Keep it to fetch this run again with get_treatment_run.

status.description: completed for a fresh result; a replayed run keeps its stored status.

title: Library
